data.name: Cheer (Emote)
data.description: Cheer Emote - Quest reward from The Right Tool
data.article: The Cheer (Emote) is a cosmetic item that lets your character perform a specific animation to express themselves. It provides a non-verbal way for Raiders to show enthusiasm, agreement, or celebrate moments with their teammates during raids. This emote is exclusively obtained as a reward when you complete the quest titled 'The Right Tool'.

data.name: Chemicals
data.description: Used to craft medical supplies, explosives, and utility items.
data.article:
Chemicals are a basic material used for crafting various items. They are also required for certain workshop upgrades and projects.

Raiders primarily find Chemicals by scavenging in Mechanical, Residential, and Medical areas across all maps. They are often found in containers like cars and bags. Popular maps for finding Chemicals include the Blue Gate and Spaceport. You can also get Chemicals from events such as Harvester and Night Raid, purchase them from Celeste at the Dam Battlegrounds, or obtain them by recycling other items.

arc.name: Firefly
arc.description:
A nastier relative to the standard Hornet, it trades its electric shock for a flamethrower capable of engulfing Raiders in seconds. Its heavy plating makes it just as difficult to bring down as its shocking sibling, but the threat it poses up close is considerably worse.

They sometimes join regular Hornets and Wasp on their patrols. They often hang back until a raider is already engaged before swooping in to flush them from cover. Veterans have learned to pick them out early - the fuel tank gives them a slightly different flight profile.

The flamethrower fuel tank is also their weakness. A well-placed shot turns the machine into a brief but spectacular fireball. Some Raiders have taken to igniting them deliberately near other ARC machines, though the timing required makes this a gambler's trick.

Apollo has been seen tinkering with its parts for weeks, muttering something about "portable heating solutions."

data.name: Coffee Pot
data.description: The power to face a new day, one drip at a time.
data.article: The Coffee Pot is a trinket used to progress the "Expedition 3" project, specifically Stage 3. Raiders obtain this item by looting residential containers. These containers are commonly found in the Pale Apartments and Ruby Residence areas within the Dam Battlegrounds map. It can also be found in the Plaza Rosa E Apartment and Grandioso Apartments of the Buried City map.

data.name: Coins
data.description: Used to buy gear from Traders. Earned by selling loot and completing quests.
data.article: Coins are a fundamental type of in-game money that Raiders earn and use in ARC Raiders. They are essential for acquiring various items, services, and upgrades that contribute to your overall strength and progression. Raiders primarily obtain them by successfully completing raids. You can gather large amounts of coins from these activities to support your efforts against the ARCs.

data.name: Combat Mk. 1
data.description: Basic combat augment. Supports stronger shields, but with limited backpack capacity and Quick Use slots.
data.article: The Combat Mk. 1 is an augment that allows you to equip a medium shield, which provides more defense during your raids. In exchange for this increased protection, this augment reduces the number of items you can carry in your backpack and limits your quick-use slots. You can get this augment by exchanging a Free Loadout Augment with Lance, crafting it at a Gear Bench, or by sometimes finding it while scavenging items.

data.name: Combat Mk. 2
data.description: A combat augment more focused on maneuverability than absorbing damage.
data.flavor_text: Restores 1 health every 5 seconds. When damage is taken, the effect is paused for 30 seconds.
data.article: The Combat Mk. 2 is a Combat augment that serves as a direct upgrade to the Combat Mk. 1. This augment focuses on helping with maneuverability and provides a passive health regeneration of 1 health every 5 seconds. Taking damage will pause this health regeneration effect for 30 seconds. It also increases your available backpack slots and weight capacity, and offers compatibility with Light, Medium, and Heavy Shield types, along with one dedicated grenade slot. Raiders can craft this augment at a Gear Bench.

data.name: Combat Mk. 3 (Aggressive)
data.description: An improved version of the Combat II augment. Supports more shield types, and comes with extra space for grenades.
data.flavor_text: Restores 2 health every 5 seconds. When damage is taken, the effect is paused for 30 seconds.
data.article: The Combat Mk. 3 (Aggressive) is an augment that builds upon the Combat Mk. 2, offering an upgraded passive ability. It provides passive health restoration, healing 2 health every 5 seconds, with the healing pausing for 30 seconds after taking damage. This augment also expands a Raider's options by supporting light, medium, and heavy shield types, and offers additional space for grenades. It can be crafted at a Gear Bench using the corresponding blueprint.

data.name: Combat Mk. 3 (Aggressive) Blueprint
data.description: An improved version of the Combat II augment. Supports more shield types and comes with extra space for grenades
data.article: The Combat Mk.3 (Aggressive) Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Combat Mk. 3 (Aggressive) augment at a Gear Bench. This augment improves upon the Combat Mk. 2 by offering compatibility with more shield types and providing extra space for grenades. When equipped, it also helps restore your health over time. It can be found as loot throughout the world, often discovered in containers or obtained after looting arcs across different maps.

data.name: Combat Mk. 3 (Flanking)
data.description: A combat augment more focused on maneuverability than absorbing damage.
data.flavor_text: Stowed or unequipped Pistols and Hand Cannon are 33% faster to equip.
data.article: The Combat Mk.3 (Flanking) is an augment that helps you move around more easily during combat. It specifically allows you to equip stowed or unequipped Pistols and Hand Cannons 33% faster, which can be helpful for quick weapon swaps. This augment is compatible with light and medium shields. You can obtain it either by scavenging in the environment or by crafting it at Gear Bench using a blueprint.

data.name: Combat Mk. 3 (Flanking) Blueprint
data.description: Lets you craft a Combat Mk. 3 (Flanking)
data.article: The Combat Mk. 3 (Flanking) Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to create the Combat Mk. 3 (Flanking), a special gear piece that enhances your combat abilities. This particular augment focuses on maneuverability, letting you equip stowed pistols and hand cannons 33% faster. It is designed to work with both light and medium shields. To acquire it, you must first find this blueprint by scavenging during your raids, and then use it at a Gear Bench to craft the item.

data.name: Comet Igniter
data.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
data.article: The Comet Igniter is a throwable item that explodes after a short delay, dealing damage to anything nearby. Its main use is to help clear out groups of Comets or deal area damage during encounters. You can craft it at an Explosives Station. Raiders obtain this item by scavenging destroyed Comets, but only if the Comet did not explode on its own. It can also be recycled for resources.

arc.name: Comet
arc.description:
Often found guarding heavy machines, the Comet serves as a brutal deterrent against Raiders who attempt flanking tactics. When it acquires a target it accelerates with alarming speed, and triggers its self-destruct once it's near enough to guarantee damage.

Its blast radius is generous and unforgiving, as grouped-up squads have learned the hard way. Its armor plating protects its core, but it opens up when it charges, exposing its vulnerable innards. However, even when exposed, hitting such a fast-moving weak spot requires a particularly skilled trigger finger.

Experienced Raiders treat the Comet as a priority target, dropping it before engaging whatever it's protecting. The alternative is fighting a Bastion while a live bomb circles for an opening. Shani suspects ARC deployed them specifically in response to Raider flanking tactics - another sign that the machines are learning

data.name: Compensator II Blueprint
data.description: Lets you craft a Compensator II
data.article: This blueprint allows Raiders to craft the Compensator II, a weapon mod that helps reduce bullet spread when firing. Raiders can find it by scavenging during raids, often inside Residential Containers. It can also be earned as a reward from Weekly Trials. Additionally, Raiders can purchase it from Shani for 100 coins, with a limit of two per day. Once learned, this blueprint is consumed and unlocks the crafting recipe at a Gunsmith Bench.

data.description: Used to craft advanced weapons.
data.flavor_text: Used to craft: Equalizer, Aphelion, Jupiter
data.article:
Complex Gun Parts are components used to craft advanced weapons.

You can obtain them through general scavenging or by defeating certain ARCs, including specific types like the Queen and Matriarch. They can also be crafted at a Refiner once you have learned the complex gun parts blueprint. Additionally, these parts can be purchased from Celeste for 60 coins, with a limit of one per day.
